eyebrow: Swap the output head for a scalar
code:
from transformers import AutoModelForSequenceClassification, AutoTokenizer

base_model = "your-base-model-name"
model = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained(
    base_model, num_labels=1)
tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(base_model)
caption: num_labels=1 turns a classifier head into a scalar regression head

eyebrow: Chosen/rejected pairs in, Bradley-Terry loss out
code:
from trl import RewardTrainer, RewardConfig

config = RewardConfig(output_dir="reward_model",
                       per_device_train_batch_size=8)
trainer = RewardTrainer(model=model, args=config,
                         tokenizer=tokenizer,
                         train_dataset=pref_dataset)
trainer.train()
caption: pref_dataset holds {"chosen": ..., "rejected": ...} pairs from lesson 36
